 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay two side-by-side binary panels; mark cells empty in both."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    mid = w // 2
    left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
    right = [row[mid:] for row in grid]
    return [
        [4 if left[r][c] == 0 and right[r][c] == 0 else 0 for c in range(mid)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
"
